base_image.name: docker.io/radixark/miles:kimi-k31
base_image.note: digests, ENV and build args read from the registry manifest and config only (no pull, no build)

base_build_args.apt_nccl: 2.28.3-1+cuda13.0 (libnccl2; the pip nvidia-nccl-cu13 2.30.7 is the one torch loads)

driver.note: CUDA 13.0 toolkit floor (R580). Modal B300 hosts (2026-11-09 smoke): driver 610.57.04 / CUDA 13.3, no /proc/driver/nvidia/version under gVisor, so the assert falls back to nvidia-smi

decisions: base: radixark/miles:kimi-k31 as upstream built it (CUDA 13.0.3, torch cu130, NCCL 2.30.7 pip, RDMA user-space libraries, gdrcopy, mooncake, DeepEP, flashinfer 0.7.2, TE, apex, Megatron-LM eb547f33e, Megatron-Bridge, TMS 118b09b3, sglang-kernel 0.4.9 with the rust extensions of v0.5.23). yeto appends one pure-Python overlay (docker/miles-k31/build.sh); nothing native is rebuilt.

overlay: the Miles fork branch (MILES_BRANCH, default k31/f1) over /root/miles, the SGLang fork branch (SGLANG_BRANCH, default yeto/k31, 35708f76 plus the yeto patches) over /sgl-workspace/sglang, peft 0.20.0 (the base has 0.18.1) and pyrage 1.4.0 (a manylinux abi3 wheel; upstream main's requirements.txt pins it) unpacked into site-packages, the lazy-modelopt patch on Megatron-LM eb547f33e and the Megatron-Bridge __init__ (a0c6d6e ships the same file as 8cd3466, byte for byte).

TMS preload: not mounted. torch_memory_saver 118b09b3 contains the double-free fix (d7a3a51 via PR #95) and TMS_INIT_ENABLE_DISK_BACKUP; the old cu13 preload .so was built against torch 2.13 and must not be mounted over this image. Asserted by the torch_memory_saver commit (the build reads it from the base's direct_url.json / build history).
miles / sglang commits: null here because they are the fork commits of each build (commits.json carries them); the image manifest records the base's own commits (921999cc / 35708f76).
boto3: optional. The s3:// store path installs it at island setup when the image lacks it (rl_island_task STORE_CLIENT_SETUP).

versions pinned from the first B300 container run (2026-11-09): torch 2.14.1+cu130, sglang 0.5.24.dev80+g35708f7, sglang-kernel 0.4.10 (the base's SGL_KERNEL_VERSION build arg says 0.4.9 but the installed dist is 0.4.10), TE 2.17.0+miles, megatron-core 0.19.0+eb547f33e, megatron-bridge 0.7.0+a0c6d6e0, torch-memory-saver 0.0.10, miles 0.1.3.
peft: the base's peft-0.18.1.dist-info is whited out by the overlay (packages.peft.replaces_base): with both dist-infos present importlib.metadata reported 0.18.1 while the import gave 0.20.0.
driver.min 580.65.06 enforced: the floor of the CUDA 13.0 toolkit; Modal runs 610.57.04 (CUDA 13.3) and CUDA 13.0 kernels JIT fine on it (sm_103 via PTX, B300 smoke).
